settings.headline: Empowering Emerging Artists to Build Sustainable Careers
settings.text: The art world has always been hard to break into — especially without the right connections. ARTCLUB changes that. We give emerging artists a real platform: to show their work, sell directly, and grow an audience that stays with them.
settings.link_label: Learn more about how we support artists

settings.headline: A World Where Art Is Part of Everyday Life
settings.text: We believe great art shouldn't live only in institutions or behind closed doors. ARTCLUB brings art into the city — through events, pop-ups, and a community of people who genuinely care about what's being made right now.

settings.title: Artist Profiles & Portfolios
settings.text: Every artist on ARTCLUB gets a dedicated profile to present their work, their story, and their process — built to be shared, discovered, and remembered.

settings.title: Live Events & Exhibitions
settings.text: We bring art off the screen and into the city. From intimate studio shows to large-scale pop-ups, ARTCLUB events are where the community comes together.

settings.title: Direct Art Sales
settings.text: Collectors buy directly from the artist — no middlemen, no inflated margins. Every transaction is transparent, and 100% of the sale price goes to the artist.

settings.title: Community & Connection
settings.text: ARTCLUB is built around people. Artists connect with collectors, collaborators, and fans who follow their journey — not just their latest work.

settings.title: Technology & Platform
settings.text: We're building the tools the art world is still missing: a modern platform where profiles, collections, events, and sales live in one place — designed for artists, not galleries.

settings.hero_headline: ARTCLUB is Berlin's Platform for Emerging Artists
settings.cta_headline: Discover the Art Being Made in Berlin  and the People Behind It
settings.story_text:
ARTCLUB started with a simple frustration: too many talented artists in Berlin with nowhere to show their work — and too many people who wanted to connect with art but didn't know where to start.

We built ARTCLUB to close that gap. Since our first event, we've supported over 30 emerging artists across six exhibitions and pop-ups in Berlin, with every sale going directly to the artist. No gallery cut. No gatekeeping.

Today, ARTCLUB is more than a platform — it's a growing community of artists, collectors, and curious minds building something together.
settings.features_text: We built ARTCLUB because we believe the art world works better when it's open. That means giving artists the tools to grow, and giving collectors and art lovers direct access to the work being made right now — without the usual barriers.
settings.team_text: ARTCLUB is built by people who care deeply about art and the artists making it. We're a small, focused team in Berlin — working at the intersection of culture, community, and technology.
